items.author: Nithya Rangarajan, Field CTO @ Snowflake., 1d
items.summary: Controlled tests of Snowflake Semantic Views for Cortex Agents found topology and size did not materially change accuracy; duplicate dimension names caused a silent wrong answer. Choose organization for governance and ownership, and name business roles clearly. 207 reactions, 2 comments, 16 reposts.
